name: 卡璞鸣鸣
description:
[C] Summon Lightning 
Search your deck for up to 2 Lightning Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
[LLC] Prize Count 90+
If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, this attack does 90 more damage.
